description.en: Ships the Agent Plan, the Team Max seat and the Coding Plan in one module. Signed Ark Agent Plan, Team seat and Coding Plan quota plus model catalogs.
description.zh: 同一模块内提供 Agent Plan、Team Max 团队席位与 Coding Plan 三档套餐。 方舟 Agent Plan、团队席位与 Coding Plan 签名配额及模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and optional Volcengine credentials for quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的火山引擎凭据。

help_text.en: Optional. Pair with the Secret below to refresh plan quota.
help_text.zh: 可选。与下方 Secret 成对填写，用于刷新套餐额度。

help_text.en: Optional. The Secret paired with the AccessKey ID above.
help_text.zh: 可选。与上方 AccessKey ID 配对的 Secret。

help_text.en: Optional. Pin quota refresh to a specific Team or Coding Plan seat.
help_text.zh: 可选。将额度刷新指定到某个 Team 或 Coding Plan 席位。
